dmz_large.text:
Remove units from this planet and place them on another planet you control. Ground forces may instead be placed in the space area of this system.

ATTACH: Units cannot be committed to, produced on, or placed on this planet. During the agenda phase, this planet's planet card can be traded as part of a transaction.

gamma.text: Place a gamma wormhole token in this system. Then, purge this card.

ionalpha.text: Place the ion storm token in this system with either side faceup. Then, place this card in the common play area. At the end of the "Move Ships" or "Retreat" substep of a tactical action during which 1 or more of your ships use the ion storm wormhole, flip the ion storm token to its opposing side.

loststation.text: Place the Lost Station token in this system. Gain the Lost Station station card and ready it. Then, purge this card.

mirage.text: Place the Mirage planet token in this system. Gain the Mirage planet card and ready it. Then, purge this card.

arcane_citadel.text: ATTACH: When you exhaust this planet, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on this planet. Apply +1 to each of your unit's combat rolls on this planet.

arcane_shield.text: ATTACH: Return all infantry on this planet to the space area or destroy them. This planet cannot be bombarded. Infantry cannot be committed to, produced on, or placed on this planet.

battleworld.text: ATTACH: At the end of your turn if this planet has no neutral units on it, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements, 1 neutral mech, and 2 neutral infantry on this planet. Those neutral units enter coexistence. When a player wins a combat against neutral units on this planet, they main gain 1 command token.

biotic.text: This planet has a green technology specialty. If this planet already has a technology specialty, this planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1 instead.

council_preserve.text: ATTACH: When you exhaust this planet to cast votes, cast 5 additional votes.

cybernetic.text: This planet has a yellow technology specialty. If this planet already has a technology specialty, this planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1 instead.

diversifiedresearchfacility.text: ATTACH: This planet may be treated as if it had a technology specialty of any color; if this planet already has a technology specialty, this planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1 instead.

dmz.text:
Remove units from this planet and place them on another planet you control. Ground forces may instead be placed in the space area of this system.

ATTACH: Units cannot be committed to, produced on, or placed on this planet. During the agenda phase, this planet's planet card can be traded as part of a transaction.

dysonsphere.text: This planet's resource value is increased by 2 and its influence value is increased by 1.

galacticheritagesite.text: ATTACH: While this planet has no units on it, it is worth a point to whoever controls it.

imperialinstitute.text: ATTACH: This planet gains a non-unit technology specialty (exhaust this planet to ignore one prerequisite on any non-unit upgrade).

lazaxsurvivors.text: This planet's resource value is increased by 1 and its influence value is increased by 2.

lloyd_interplanetaryhub.text: ATTACH: Whenever you ready this planet, draw 1 action card, or 2 if you have the Neural Motivators technology.

lloyd_traderoute.text: ATTACH: Whenever you exhaust this planet, gain 1 commodity.

manufactorum.text: ATTACH: While this planet has a spacedock, it is legendary and worth a point to whoever controls it. Any structures on this planet are treated as though you had their unit upgrade technologies if you do not have them. When you produce units in this system, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

miningworld.text: This planet's resource value is increased by 2.

nanoforge.text:
ACTION: Attach this card to a non-legendary, non-home planet you control. Its resource and influence values are increased by 2 and it is a legendary planet. Take the corresponding legendary planet ability card. This action cannot be performed once attached.
RECONSTRUCTION MATRIX: After you exhaust the planet Nano-Forge is attached to, you may exhaust this card to ready that planet.

orbital_foundries.text: ATTACH: This planet has a PRODUCTION value of 2 as if it were a unit.

paradiseworld.text: This planet's influence value is increased by 2.

polymorphism.text: ATTACH: When you exhaust this planet, you may replace 1 non-fighter ship you control with 1 ship from your reinforcements with a cost up to 1 more than that returned ship.

propulsion.text: This planet has a blue technology specialty. If this planet already has a technology specialty, this planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1 instead.

richworld.text: This planet's resource value is increased by 1.

sigma_ancient_hall.text: This planet is not exhausted when used to cast votes.

sigma_deserted_factories.text: This planet gains the PRODUCTION 2 ability as if it were a unit.

sigma_palace_admirals.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Warfare" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. The owner of this card does not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Warfare" strategy card.

sigma_palace_architects.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Construction" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. The owner of this card does not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Construction" strategy card.

sigma_palace_diplomats.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Diplomacy" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. The owner of this card does not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Diplomacy" strategy card.

sigma_palace_merchants.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Trade" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. When resolving the secondary ability of the "Trade" strategy card, the owner of this card may either not spend a command token, or convert their commodities.

sigma_palace_politicians.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Politics" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. The owner of this card does not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Politics" strategy card.

sigma_palace_scientists.text:
This card is attached exhausted.
When the owner of this card resolved the primary ability of the "Technology" strategy card, they may exhaust this card to gain 1 victory point. The owner of this card does not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card.

sigma_senate_sanctuary.text: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The influence value of this planet is increased by 2.

sigma_unwelcoming.text: When this is attached, assign 1 hit to a ground force on this planet. During an invasion, this planet gains the SPACE CANNON 8 (xX) ability as if it were a unit, rolling 1 dice for each unit committed by another player to this planet. Game effects cannot prevent, modify or reroll this space cannon roll.

superweapon_availyn.text: This system is a nebula. At any time, you may exhaust this card to produce up to 3 fighters in a system that contains your ships. PRODUCTION 3

superweapon_caled.text: During combat, if a straight line between the center of this system and the center of the active system would cross only parallel non-anomaly borders, you may exhaust this card to destroy 1 ship in that system.

superweapon_glatison.text: At any time, you may exhaust this card to repair all of your damaged units. Up to 5 fighters in this system do not count against your ships’ capacity.ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 4(x2).

superweapon_grom.text: At any time, you may exhaust this card to resolve ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE 4 against each fighter in 1 adjacent system (including your own).

superweapon_mors.text: At any time, you may exhaust this card to force each unit in 1 non-adjacent system to become damaged, if able. PLANETARY SHIELD

tombofemphidia.text: This planet's influence value is increased by 1. If the player who has the "Crown of Emphidia" relic has control of this planet, they can use that relic to gain 1 VP.

warfare.text: This planet has a red technology specialty. If this planet already has a technology specialty, this planet's resource and influence values are each increased by 1 instead.

weapon.text: ATTACH: This planet gains a unit technology specialty (exhaust this planet to ignore one prerequisite on any unit upgrade).
